subject: Required PO, SLA details and data-subprocessing declaration
messages:
From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@bluemount.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@bluemount.io
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation — PO path and security artifacts request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. To get Bluemount activated in our vendor portal we need a quick checklist so our procurement team can raise a PO: billing entity name, invoice remit-to, standard SLA expectations, and the signed DPA. Also our security team would like a link to your most recent SOC 2 report and the list of subprocessors you use for data processing.

Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a vendor PO before go-live or if we can start on a trial invoice while contracts finish? We have internal procurement lead on copy.

Attachments: none

Thanks,
Tom Wallace
Head of Integrations | Bluemount Analytics
Tom.Wallace@bluemount.io
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@bluemount.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation — PO path and security artifacts request

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: we prefer a PO for production activation, but can approve a 30-day pilot without a PO on a case-by-case basis (billing holds apply). See the checklist below — please return the signed DPA and subprocessor table; once we receive those we will route to finance for PO creation.

Redwood activation checklist for Bluemount:
- Signed DPA (we have a standard template; redlines must be agreed before PO)
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report and the report issue date (link acceptable)
- Full subprocessor list with roles and regions (country of processing)
- Billing entity, remit-to address, and W-9 or equivalent (for US entities)
- Desired SLA (throughput/latency targets) and any variance requests
- PO billing contact and purchase order email address

Process notes: when the DPA and subprocessors are received, I’ll send to Legal for a rapid review and to Ben in Finance to create PO_567342 (provisionally). If you need a pilot, confirm billing approval and I’ll mark the engagement as time-limited.

Useful links:
- Redwood DPA template: https://redwood-drive.internal/docs/dpa-template-v3.docx
- SOC 2 upload: securityreports@redwood.ai (or a public link works)

Requested timeline: please return the signed DPA and subprocessor list by EOD Thu (23 Jul) so we can meet a go-live in the first week of August.

Thanks — cc’ing Ben for PO routing and Rishi for subprocessor clarifications.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
From: contracts@bluemount.io <contracts@bluemount.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@bluemount.io>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor activation — PO path and security artifacts request

Olga — attaching the items you requested. We’ve signed your DPA (minor administrative signature) and exported our current subprocessor registry. Also included is our billing certificate (W-9) and a short note on our proposed SLA for the integration.

Attachments:
- Bluemount_Signed_DPA.pdf (signed 2026-07-23)
- Bluemount_Subprocessors_List.xlsx (includes vendor role, country, and contact)
- Bluemount_W9.pdf

SLA summary (proposed):
- 99.5% API availability measured monthly
- 95th percentile request latency below 300ms for payloads up to 1k tokens
- Support: business hours email; optional paid 24x7 via add-on

We’re OK to start the pilot without PO under a 30-day invoice, but prefer to get the PO in place before production rollout. Please confirm receipt and next steps.

Thanks,
Contracts Team
Bluemount Analytics
contracts@bluemount.io

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@bluemount.io>, contracts@bluemount.io
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: PO_567342 created — terms and next steps

Tom / Bluemount team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the signed DPA. I’ve generated PO_567342 (attached) under Redwood’s standard Net 30 terms. Key reminders:
- PO applies to production activation only; pilot invoices should be sent to pilot-invoices@redwood.ai and will be processed separately.
- SLA exceptions requested (300ms latency target) are noted. We’ll accept the SLA as an appendix to the PO but need confirmation on capacity commitments (expected QPS) to finalize.
- Subprocessors reviewed by Rishi — he flagged two entries that operate in non-EU countries; Rishi will follow up separately with a short questionnaire.

Next steps:
1) Bluemount to confirm expected QPS and whether 24x7 support will be purchased.
2) Rishi to send subprocessor questionnaire (small form) — please complete within 3 business days.
3) On receipt of confirmed QPS and completed questionnaire, finance will finalize the PO and we’ll schedule the provisioning call with Engineering.

Attachment: PO_567342.pdf

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
